_comment: Single source of truth for all Taste the World events. Edit this file (directly on GitHub or locally) to add / update / remove events. The site renders Upcoming vs Past automatically based on each event's `date`. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD. Default schedule: 1st Sunday of each month, 4:15-5:45 PM, at Heritage Community Center.

events.title: 🎉 Kick-Off Event — Taste the World Launch Party!
events.description: Our very first event! Come kick off Taste the World with an afternoon of food, stories, and play. Travel station-to-station through hands-on adventures: 🔍 treasure-hunt / escape-room style games, 🧪 food-science mini-experiments, and 📖 history-story challenges where kids guess which historical moment a food belongs to. Collect enough station stamps and earn a ticket to make your own 🧋 bubble tea or 🍭 cotton candy at the prize bar!
highlights: 🔍 Treasure-hunt & escape-room style games
🧪 Food-science mini experiments
📖 Food-history story challenges
🎫 Stamp your card to unlock bubble-tea & cotton-candy stations
events.notice: ⚠️ Heads up: this event is NOT nut-free. Please check with a volunteer about ingredients before your child tries anything if you have allergies.

events.title: Vietnam — Fresh Spring Rolls & Pandan Sweets
events.description: A summer trip to Vietnam through two crowd-favorites: Gỏi cuốn (fresh spring rolls) — a translucent, herb-packed roll that's part art project, part healthy snack — and silky green pandan desserts. We'll learn about Vietnamese street-food culture, roll our own rainbow rolls, and discover why pandan is called the 'vanilla of Asia.'
highlights: 🌯 Roll your own Gỏi cuốn (fresh spring rolls)
🍀 Make pandan jelly & coconut-pandan dessert from scratch
🇻🇳 Stories of Vietnamese street food, herb gardens & the magical pandan leaf
ingredients: Agar-agar, coconut milk, sugar (for jelly & dessert)

events.title: China — Mid-Autumn Mooncakes
events.description: Celebrate China's Mid-Autumn Festival (中秋节) — the night families gather under the full moon to share stories, lanterns, and mooncakes (月饼). We'll share the legend of Chang'e flying to the moon, knead and stamp our own mini mooncakes with beautiful patterns, and taste classic fillings together.
highlights: 🌕 The legend of Chang'e & the Mid-Autumn Festival
🥮 Stamp your own mini mooncakes with traditional molds
🏮 Try classic fillings: lotus seed, red bean & custard
ingredients: Mooncake dough (flour, golden syrup, alkaline water, oil)

events.title: Japan — Sushi Around Japan
events.description: Travel across Japan through its most beloved food — sushi! From hand-rolled temaki cones to colorful maki rolls, pressed oshizushi, and bite-sized nigiri, we'll learn the stories behind each style and craft our own sushi platter together.
highlights: 🍣 Roll maki (rolled sushi) with rainbow fillings
🍙 Shape nigiri & wrap temaki hand-cones
🇯🇵 Discover the regional sushi styles of Japan
ingredients: Imitation crab, smoked salmon, tuna (or tofu/egg for veggie)

events.title: Mexico — Tacos & Día de los Muertos
events.description: Tacos meet Día de los Muertos! November 1–2 is Mexico's Day of the Dead — a colorful celebration honoring loved ones with food, flowers, and stories. We'll explore the tradition, press fresh tortillas, mix salsas, and build our own tacos. Pick a filling, fold, fiesta!
highlights: 💀 The joyful story of Día de los Muertos
🌮 Press your own tortillas & build a taco
🌶️ Mix-your-own salsa bar (mild to spicy!)
ingredients: Chicken or beef (or beans for veggie)

events.title: America — Christmas Gingerbread Men & Houses
events.description: It's December — let's build a sweet little gingerbread world! We'll bake (or pre-bake) gingerbread men and assemble candy-covered houses, while sharing the cozy story of how gingerbread became a holiday tradition across America and Europe.
highlights: 🍪 Decorate gingerbread men with royal icing
🏠 Build & decorate your own gingerbread house
🎄 The sweet history of holiday gingerbread

events.title: France & Italy — Epiphany & Tiramisu Tales
events.description: Welcome the new year European style! Epiphany (Jan 6) closes the Christmas season in France and Italy with kings, queens, and sweet treats. We'll share the stories — including the famous French Galette des Rois — and then layer up an Italian classic: tiramisu, the dessert whose name means 'pick me up.'
highlights: 👑 The story of Epiphany & the Three Kings
🍰 Layer your own personal tiramisu cup
🇫🇷🇮🇹 Two countries, one sweet New Year tradition

events.title: China — Dumplings & Yuanxiao (Lunar New Year)
events.description: Lunar New Year 2027 falls on Feb 6 — we celebrate the day after! Dumplings (饺子) for reunion, and Yuanxiao / Tangyuan (元宵/汤圆) — sweet sticky-rice balls eaten at the Lantern Festival, symbolizing family togetherness. Stories, folding, rolling, eating.
highlights: 🥟 Fold your own dumplings (10+ shapes!)
🏮 Roll Yuanxiao / Tangyuan — sweet sticky-rice balls
🐉 The stories of Chinese New Year & the Lantern Festival
ingredients: Ground pork or chicken (or tofu/mushroom for veggie)
Soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar
Black sesame paste or red bean paste (Yuanxiao filling)

events.title: Team Mission Season
events.description: Teams form and draw a mission — a country, a dish, a story. Over three months, kids research the history, study the foods and stories from every past Taste the World episode and event (it's needed for the quiz round!), bring their mission to life in any form their crew chooses — talk, skit, stage play, song, poster, video — and practice cooking the dish. Junior Chefs lead, Mini Chefs learn.
highlights: 🎲 Draw your team's mission country & dish
🎭 Bring it to life: skit, song, video — your call
🍳 Practice cooking the dish for the June finale
ingredients: To be decided by each team based on their drawn mission

events.title: 🏆 Grand Finale — Culinary Contest & Team Showcase
events.description: The big day! Each team shares their country and dish however they've chosen — story, skit, stage play, song, video, or anything in between (Showcase, 80 pts); then a fast-paced food-knowledge quiz round on every past dish and story (Quiz, 20 pts); and finally the awards ceremony. The winning team takes home a **$50 gift card** — and bragging rights until next season.
highlights: 🎭 Team showcases (80 pts)
❓ Food-knowledge quiz round (20 pts)
🏆 Awards ceremony — $50 gift card for the winning team
ingredients: Each team brings ingredients for their chosen dish
Organizers provide quiz materials and prizes
